subject: gk
question: With reference to international diplomacy, what is Quad?

options.text: It is an informal strategic forum between the US, Japan, Israel and India.
It is an informal strategic forum between the US, Japan, Britain and India.
It is an informal strategic forum between the US, Taiwan, Australia and India.
It is an informal strategic forum between the US, Japan, Australia, and India.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is an informal strategic forum between the US, Japan, Australia, and India.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The first-ever leader-level summit of four QUAD (Quadrilateral Security Dialogue) countries took place virtually.
 
• The top leaders of India, the US, Japan, and Australia hosted the summit.
 
• The leaders discussed regional and global issues of shared interest, and exchanged views on practical areas of cooperation toward maintaining a free, open, and inclusive Indo-Pacific region.
 
• The summit provided an opportunity to exchange views on contemporary challenges such as resilient supply chains, emerging and critical technologies, maritime security, and climate change.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The four Quad member countries have been resolving to uphold a rules-based international order in the Indo-Pacific.
 
• Participants-
 
 
• Prime Minister-Narendra Modi
 
• Prime Minister of Australia-Anthony Albanese
 
• Prime Minister of Japan-Yoshihide Suga
 
• President of USA-Joseph R. Biden
